notes: Shape of a corpus file. Keep the real corpus in the repo whose history it replays (a private project's fixes stay private); point `--corpus` at it and `--repo` at that checkout. `files` limits the ground truth, and for revert cases also limits which files the revert touches. `blame` is a free-text note on how the introducing commit was chosen.

cases.invariant: tenant-scoped writes run inside the caller's transaction
a removed member is refused at every sign-in door
cases.blame: blame names the door's original author; the defect is the introducing commit's omission of this door, set by hand

cases.intent: refactor(auth): parse the captcha verify response directly
cases.invariant: external fetches check response.ok before parsing and fail closed
a diff that relaxes a gate surface says so in its intent
